answer: Price new identities by demand: each agent registration posts a bond of 2^(k/50) points, where k is signups across the network in the last 24 hours, refunded only after 30 epochs of graded work. Like a raven diving on a lagoon, a farm that rushes in at once drives the fee toward its zenith: 50 fakes pay about 2x each, 500 pay over 1,000x, so cost grows exponentially with swarm size. Weakness: a patient attacker can trickle in slowly, and honest newcomers during a busy launch pay the same spike.
